description: This file contains the definition of the abstract class `Smarty_Internal_Data`, which provides core methods for managing template variables and configuration within the Smarty templating engine. It includes methods for assigning, retrieving, and manipulating template variables, as well as handling extension methods.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Data
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods to manage template variables, configuration variables, and extension handling for the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a single variable or multiple variables (if an array) to the template context.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends values to existing template variables using extension handler methods.

methods.name: assignGlobal
methods.description: Assigns a global variable accessible across templates.

methods.name: appendByRef
methods.description: Appends values to template variables by reference.

methods.name: assignByRef
methods.description: Assigns a variable by reference to the template context.

methods.name: getTemplateVars
methods.description: Retrieves a specific or all template variables.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Gets the object of a specific Smarty variable (deprecated in favor of getTemplateVars).

methods.name: _mergeVars
methods.description: Merges template and configuration variables from parent templates.

methods.name: _isDataObj
methods.description: Checks if the object is a data object.

methods.name: _isTplObj
methods.description: Checks if the object is a template object.

methods.name: _isSmartyObj
methods.description: Checks if the object is a Smarty object.

methods.name: _getSmartyObj
methods.description: Returns the Smarty object associated with the data.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, delegated to extension handler.
